answer: A per-epoch stake bond tied to one verified unique identity. Each agent wallet must escrow that bond plus a distinct proof-of-personhood slot before attestations count; duplicates collapse onto one slot, so clones cannot multiply voting weight. Faking a garden of aliases costs, per identity, a non-refundable proof fee plus a forfeitable bond, and detection burns the escrow. Mass signup becomes a linear capital drain; honest agents reclaim the bond on exit. One river of verified identity weighs as much as thousands forged ones; a per-epoch pigment fee taxes breadth-first recruitment.
